# CANDIDATE: RIBBON_STACK_BREAK_WITH_VOLUME_SPIKE

**Filed:** 2026-07-09
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)
**Type:** new_trigger
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

When the EMA ribbon (9,20,50) is aligned and price breaks above/below the ribbon with a volume spike, it signals the start of a short‑term momentum move. This captures edge by entering early on ribbon breaks with volume confirmation, avoiding the need for a prior rejection/reclaim event.

## Mechanism

Entry: If EMA9 > EMA20 > EMA50 (bullish alignment) and price closes above EMA9 with volume > 1.5 * average volume of the last 20 bars, go long; if EMA9 < EMA20 < EMA50 (bearish alignment) and price closes below EMA9 with volume > 1.5 * average volume, go short.
Exit: Initial stop = opposite side of the ribbon (below EMA20 for longs, above EMA20 for shorts); target = 1.5 * ATR from entry or trail using a chandelier exit (ATR*3) after 1R profit.
Regime hints: Best during medium volatility (VIX 15‑25) and after the first 30 minutes to avoid opening noise; avoid choppy days where the ribbon is frequently tangled (ribbon duration < 5 bars).
